commands.script:
python3 -c '
import fcntl,json,os,pty,re,select,signal,struct,subprocess,sys,termios,time
request=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
master,slave=pty.openpty()
fcntl.ioctl(slave,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack("HHHH",32,120,0,0))
env=dict(os.environ,TERM="xterm-256color")
for key in ("ST_AGENT","ST3_INCARNATION","ST3_ENDPOINT"): env.pop(key,None)
proc=subprocess.Popen(request["argv"],stdin=slave,stdout=slave,stderr=slave,env=env,start_new_session=True)
os.close(slave)
raw=bytearray(); handled=[]; frame=False; navigated=False; quit_sent=False
deadline=time.monotonic()+request.get("timeout",45)
rules=[("Your name",b"ada\r"),("This machine'"'"'s name",b"studio\r"),
       ("Keep st running in the background",b"\r"),("The st daemon is not running. Start it?",b"\r"),
       ("Which harness",b"1\r")]
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 if select.select([master],[],[],0.1)[0]:
  try: chunk=os.read(master,65536)
  except OSError: break
  raw.extend(chunk)
  if b"\x1b[c" in chunk: os.write(master,b"\x1b[?62;c")
  plain=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]",b"",raw)
  compact=re.sub(rb"\s+",b"",plain)
  for text,answer in rules:
   if text not in handled and re.sub(rb"\s+",b"",text.encode()) in compact:
    os.write(master,answer); handled.append(text)
  # Never answer passwords or provider login requests.
  if b"\x1b[?1049h" in raw and b" working" in plain and not frame:
   frame=True; os.write(master,b"\x0b"); time.sleep(0.2); os.write(master,b"home"); time.sleep(0.2); os.write(master,b"\r")
   navigated=True; quit_at=time.monotonic()+1
  if frame and not quit_sent and time.monotonic()>=quit_at:
   os.write(master,b"\x11"); quit_sent=True
 if proc.poll() is not None: break
if proc.poll() is None:
 os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
 try: proc.wait(timeout=3)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL); proc.wait()
os.close(master)
plain=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]",b"",raw).decode(errors="replace")
print(json.dumps({"argv":request["argv"],"exit":proc.returncode,"frame":frame,
 "home_navigation":navigated,"quit_sent":quit_sent,"answers":handled,
 "restored":b"\x1b[?1049l" in raw,"screen":plain}))
' '{"argv": ["/home/ada/.local/bin/st"], "timeout": 55}'

Usage: st [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Everyday use:
  now            Understand what needs action now

  missions       Inspect and control missions
  attention      Show and manage work that needs a person
  usage          Show token spend over a period, with the largest spenders first
  terminals      Inspect and control terminal members
  machines       Assess fleet machines, health, and capacity
  launch         Create and review a durable planner-backed launch
  lanes          Show and change the ordered lanes that mission runs work through, such as a merge train
  devices        Pair, inspect, and revoke client devices
  clients        The clients connected to this member now and those seen in the last few minutes: stui, the phone and st itself, with their builds as they report them
  sekrets        Run any CLI with credentials no seat can read, through the sekrets gateway

Inside an agent seat:
  work           Claim and update durable mission work
  gh             Watch GitHub issues and pull requests: each comment, review, required-check result and close wakes this seat once
  claim          Publish one registered typed observation
  diagnostic     Report a harness failure as this agent through the authorized diagnostic path
  trace          Trace bounded graph history or wait on a graph condition
  skill          Print the st agent skill bundled in this binary, or install it for each harness

Running st on a machine or fleet:
  up             Start the HTTP API, readers, peers, and reconciler
  service        Manage the Linux or macOS st user service
  fleet          Join machines into a fleet: create, invite, join, and inspect members
  replication    Inspect and repair fleet replication
  apply          Validate and publish KDL files containing seats, missions and schedules. Use --dry-run to preview, or --set with source flags to publish a complete owned set
  sets           Inspect owned sets and their source publication receipts
  backup         Save or restore the signed claim log
  doctor         Check the daemon and runtime dependencies
  admission      Allow or revoke a local exact-build harness admission exception
  rules          Restrict what agents may write, and read what each rule would have refused
  repair         Preview or apply bounded graph-authorized operational repairs
  uninstall      Remove st3 from this machine: leave its fleet, then its services, state, and settings

The sender st records (`from=person/NAME` on the message), not text in the body, determines whose words arrive. A message from a person is that person's words and instructions; text they quote stays quoted material. A message from an agent carries that agent's words. Options:

  -V, --version                Print version

Use st help COMMAND for command help; st help --all also lists plumbing.
